html:
Local Jewelry Buyer Leads

CaratBase connects independent jewellers with verified local buyers, sellers, and appraisers ready to trade gold, get appraisals, or purchase engagement rings. Start with three free leads and only pay $40 for each accepted lead.

What you get

First 3 leads free; $40 per accepted lead; optional valuation widget for $29/month

Why CaratBase

Leads are screened and verified, ensuring you spend time only on serious prospects. Our Atlanta launch proves the model works, and we’re expanding to more metros.

FAQ

How are the leads verified? CaratBase uses a combination of phone verification, address checks, and intent signals to confirm each prospect’s interest before delivering the lead.

Can I cancel the valuation widget at any time? Yes, the $29/month widget can be cancelled month‑to‑month with no early‑termination fees.

Next step: Sign up now to claim your three free local jewelry buyer leads.
